First Friday Ride

Durham, NC · Downtown · Social

No-drop

First Friday Ride is a social group ride in Durham, NC. It rolls first Friday of the month at 7:30 pm from CCB Plaza. About 10–15 miles, 8–12 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @firstfridayride the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the First Friday Ride group ride

A monthly night ride from the bull statue downtown. Ten to fifteen miles at an easy pace, no-drop, ending somewhere different each time. Any bike, casual clothes.
